native_thinking_reference_scope: Retain the existing frozen Native assay cohorts as the paper's Native reference. Fresh Qwen/Gemma Thinking shared-cohort reruns are separately labeled; Gemma FOUND is an Update auxiliary and must not replace natural Native Read/Relay.
